top_signals.title: Philippines Retail Bond Auction Draws Billions as Rates Rise
top_signals.summary: The Philippines raised 84.9 billion pesos ($1.36 billion) in a retail Treasury bond auction, securing fresh funds for government spending while opting for a shorter tenor as interest rates remain high.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Dongshan Precision Is Said to Target Up to $3 Billion HK Listing
top_signals.summary: Printed circuit board maker Suzhou Dongshan Precision Manufacturing Co. aims to raise $2 billion to $3 billion in its planned Hong Kong listing, according to people familiar with the matter.
